The '''portable computer bank''' was a mobile data storage platform with a large memory capacity. It measured one [[Meter/Legends|meter]] by one meter by two meters long and moved on a low hover cushion. The [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] used a portable computer bank to download all the information from their [[ISB headquarters office|headquarters]] prior to evacuating the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
